title: sharpen-preserve — the Preservation lens (issue-sharpening 02)
description: One fresh reviewer's comparison of each change row's original criterion with what replaced it: does the proposal keep the same requirement. `audit_gate` checks the Input receipt and judges the round. _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

pairs.description: One entry per row of changes.md.

verdict.description: same: the same requirement. substitution: a weaker or different behaviour presented as the same requirement. contradiction_resolved: the change picks a side between a criterion and a non-goal.

findings.description: What is wrong with the proposal. [] when nothing is.

severity.description: blocker: the proposal must not be applied as it is. major: a real problem that must be fixed first. nit: worth saying, never blocks.

criterion_ref.description: `AC<n>` of the original criterion the finding is about, or null when it is about the whole proposal.

evidence.description: Where the finding comes from: path:line in the checkout, `proposed.md`, `changes.md`, `original_criteria.md` or `ci.md`.

says.description: What is there, quoted or in one sentence.
